truth_definitions.event_hole: truth_sev = clip(1 - min_case_si_sdr/30, 0, 1) over exact-reference remix cases; truly_bad iff min case SI-SDR < 6.0 dB. proxy_raw = clip(1 - min_rc_si_sdr/30, 0, 1) (seed formula on the actual-construction A-V(A) vs A SI-SDR over genuine controls; deployable without synthetic truth).
truth_definitions.orchestral_theft: truth_sev = clip(1 - min_rc_si_sdr/40, 0, 1); truly_bad iff min over controls of actual-construction SI-SDR < 20.0 dB (A is exact truth for a control). proxy_raw = theft_mean (mean broadband stem-energy theft ratio on controls).
truth_definitions.fullness: truth_sev = clip(mean_case_band_envelope_err/30, 0, 1) over exact cases; truly_bad iff mean case band_envelope_err > 6.0 dB. proxy_raw = clip(mean_rc_band_envelope_err/30, 0, 1) on controls (seed formula). NOTE: fullness is not in CRITICAL_DEFECTS; calibrated for reporting.
